描述_EN: the teapots are not usually glazed, but burnished and fired, and unlike the majority of chinese crafts, they can be signed by the potters. this teapot is an example of yixing ware produced at the beginning of the qing dynasty (1644-1910). the local clays in yixing have a high sand content and can be cream, red or warm brown. this example has an incised mark reading: 'made by hui mengchen in jingqi' (an old name for yixing). the yixing kilns, in the jangsu province of eastern china, have been known since the 16th century for their teapots.
描述_ZN: 茶壶通常不上釉，而是经过烧制，与大多数中国工艺品不同，它们可以由陶工签名。 此茶壶是清朝初年（1644-1910）生产的宜兴器的一个例子。 宜兴当地的粘土含沙量很高，可以是奶油色、红色或暖褐色。 这个例子有一个刻印的标记： 由惠孟臣在景岐制作"（宜兴的一个旧称）。 中国东部江苏省的宜兴窑，自16世纪以来就以其茶壶而闻名。
